usedFor: Shopify holds the store's products, and My Dukaan receives each new one through “Add Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Add Product” in My Dukaan
bestTemplate.why: The product is added to your Dukaan store, so both catalogs start from the same item.

watchOut: “New Product” fires on new products only, so later edits in Shopify do not reach My Dukaan.
